rule: Predict a home margin of exactly 0.00.
note: The do-nothing baseline. A model that cannot beat this has no value.

rule: Predict the point-in-time mean home margin over all prior non-neutral games; predict 0.00 at a neutral site.
Predict a + b * (home point differential per game minus away point differential per game), with HFA suppressed at neutral sites. a and b are fitted on weeks 2-4 only and then frozen.
Predict the point-in-time league mean game total.
Predict 0.5 * (home points per game + away points per game) + 0.5 * (home points allowed per game + away points allowed per game).
note: Raw team-rate total with no regression toward the mean.

rule: Predict c + d * x where x is the F-TOTAL-NAIVE quantity. c and d are fitted on weeks 2-4 only and then frozen.
note: Our own originated total, shrunk toward the league mean by the fit.
